description:
[WRITE] Record one successful repayment against a wallet's ladder.

Advances the limit deterministically: 1 -> $25, 3 -> $50, 6 -> $100, 10 -> $250 and
status graduated, at which point standard underwriting prices the real limit and
APR. Refuses after a default. Only call it for a repayment that actually happened.
name: record_credit_ladder_repayment
